name: Almost Heaven Spectacle 2-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Spectacle 2-Person Indoor Sauna The Spectacle sauna offers a lavish retreat with its premium heat retention softwood lumber, renowned for its outstanding natural insulation. Whether you fancy the refined elegance of hemlock or the rugged charm of cedar, this sauna assures a revitalizing escape. Handcrafted in America, the emphasis on quality is evident in the walls and ceiling constructed from sturdy profiled timbers, intricately assembled in a tongue and groove style for durability and superior heat retention. The floor-to-ceiling glass layout contributes to a contemporary ambiance, highlighting the sauna's exquisite interior and multi-tiered seating arrangement. Get ready to immerse in Löyly, the invigorating steam and heat combination that renews the senses, complemented by a heater of your choice. Choose a WiFi-compatible heater for convenient control via your phone, anytime, anywhere. This sauna has an expected shipping lead time of 1-2 weeks.
